signaling_summary: Per-module single-ended (not differential) data lanes carrying unencoded NRZ at 4/8/12/16/24/32 GT/s, source-synchronous to a per-module forwarded Track/clock lane, with a per-module Valid lane framing the data. The very short, low-loss on-package channel (Advanced <=2 mm, Standard <=25 mm) and fine bump pitch permit single-ended signaling without a DC-balancing line code; integrity is provided at the D2D Adapter by a 16-bit per-Flit CRC + Retry. A separate always-on sideband (2 lanes/direction @ 800 MHz) handles training, management, and registers. UCIe targets Tx+Rx latency < 2 ns and power efficiency 0.5 pJ/b (Standard) / 0.25 pJ/b (Advanced).
clocking: Source-synchronous forwarded clock (Track lane), NOT an embedded/recovered clock. The receiver samples the data lanes against the forwarded clock; a calibration/track lane maintains alignment.

transmitter_specs_canonical.line_encoding: none (unencoded; integrity via Adapter 16-bit Flit CRC + Retry)
transmitter_specs_canonical.per_module_extra_lanes: 1 Valid lane + 1 forwarded Track/clock lane (per direction)
transmitter_specs_canonical.interop_rule: Must support all data rates up to the advertised maximum.

receiver_specs_canonical.clock_strobe: Samples data lanes against the per-module forwarded Track/clock.
receiver_specs_canonical.valid_framing: Uses the Valid lane to qualify mainband data.
receiver_specs_canonical.lane_repair: Can remap a failing data lane to a spare lane (Advanced) or degrade width (Standard).
receiver_specs_canonical.calibration: Per-module track/calibration lane maintains receiver sampling alignment.

standard_package.bump_out: UCIe-S (Standard) bump-out, stacked or unstacked variants

advanced_package.type: 2.5D silicon interposer / bridge (e.g. CoWoS, EMIB, FoCoS)
advanced_package.bump_out: UCIe-A (Advanced) bump-out; supports spare lanes for repair

sideband.carries: data + clock; used for training, debug, management, configuration registers.
sideband.note: Leverages depopulated bumps so it adds no extra shoreline.

latency.scope: Includes D2D Adapter and PHY (FDI to bump and back).
latency.low_power_entry_exit_latency: 0.5 ns at <=16 GT/s; 0.5-1 ns at >=24 GT/s.

reliability.fit_target: 0 < FIT << 1 (~1E-10 failures/hour) with UCIe Flit Mode
reliability.mechanism: Spare lanes (Advanced) / width degradation (Standard) + Flit CRC/Retry.

encoding_role_in_analog: Because the on-package channel is extremely short and low-loss, UCIe omits a line code (no 8b/10b / 128b/130b) and uses a forwarded clock; transition density and DC balance are not required for clock recovery. Data integrity is instead handled digitally by the 16-bit Flit CRC + Retry in the D2D Adapter.
